overview: The Company Switcher drop-in provides **3 API functions** for managing company context and headers in multi-company B2B scenarios.

getCustomerCompanyInfo.description: Retrieves the customer's current company context information including the active company ID, company name, and list of available companies for the user.
getCustomerCompanyInfo.events: Does not emit any drop-in events.
getCustomerCompanyInfo.usageScenarios:
- Determine which company is currently active
- Load company-specific data on page load
- Check if user has company access
- Display current company information
- Conditional rendering based on company context
- Populate company dropdown selector with available companies

setCompanyHeaders.description: Sets the company-specific headers that will be included in subsequent GraphQL requests. This ensures all API calls operate within the context of the specified company.

companyId.description: The unique identifier of the company to set as active context. Pass `null` to remove company headers.

setCompanyHeaders.events: Emits the [`companyContext/changed`](/dropins-b2b/company-switcher/events/#companycontextchanged) event after successfully setting or removing the company headers.
setCompanyHeaders.usageScenarios:
- Switch between companies for multi-company users
- Set company context after user selection
- Initialize company context on page load
- Change active company from a dropdown selector
- Restore company context from session storage
- Remove company context by passing `null`

asides.content: After calling `setCompanyHeaders()`, all subsequent GraphQL requests will operate in the context of the specified company. Ensure you refresh all company-dependent data after switching companies.
Passing `null` to `setCompanyHeaders()` removes the company context headers from all GraphQL requests. This is useful when logging out or switching to a non-company user context.

setGroupHeaders.description: Sets the customer group headers that will be included in subsequent GraphQL requests. This is used to ensure proper pricing and catalog visibility based on customer group.

groupId.description: The unique identifier of the customer group to set. Pass `null` to remove group headers.

setGroupHeaders.events: Does not emit any drop-in events.
setGroupHeaders.usageScenarios:
- Set customer group context for proper pricing
- Apply group-specific catalog rules
- Initialize group context on login
- Switch groups for testing or admin purposes
- Coordinate with company context changes

asides.content: Customer group changes typically happen automatically based on the company context. You usually only need to call `setGroupHeaders()` directly in advanced scenarios like admin impersonation or testing.
